properties.description:
Graph-specific iteration resumed at the user's request after the architecture interview. Query composer work is queued until after the user has slept; this iteration addresses layout spacing and shared expansion modes only.

Source: the user's latest five-annotation Graph editor review. This child preserves annotations 1, 2, 3 and 4. Annotation 5 about materialized engine identities belongs to the separate engine-composition discussion and is excluded here.

## Annotation 1 — unequal leaf distance (verbatim)
surprisingly one dot is closer then the other.

Evidence context: Graph editor, force-directed layout, Node px 28, Edge px 1, 100% zoom. Selected node graph://planning-26535745-4644-4770-af7c-1980c773377b/entries/97061430-fa40-415b-9a0d-0d91ca77c545.json. The screenshot shows a centre with surrounding leaves; the marked lower-left leaf is noticeably nearer the centre. Browser annotation coordinate (373, 436) in a 1480x764 viewport. Target: relational-ui-circle-graph > relational-ui-scroll-area.

## Annotation 2 — node overlaps an unrelated edge (verbatim)
edge themselves do not seems to have a repulsing effect for nodes meaning we can reach this case were the node overlap the edge when there is to of free space around.

Evidence context: selected node planning:buildspace/resolution/optional, force-directed layout, Node px 28, Edge px 1, 67.03% zoom. A large radial cluster connects to sparse branches. The marked lower-left branch has a node on an edge despite nearby unused space. Browser annotation coordinate (132, 561) in a 1480x764 viewport. Target: relational-ui-circle-graph > relational-ui-scroll-area.

## Annotation 3 — shared expansion-mode control (verbatim)
i want you to transform collapse all and expand all into a relational ui component as follow :

Combine them into two radio buttons, clicking retrigger collapse all / expand all in addition of switching the defaut expension mode when you switch item.

In addition i would add a third mode for the radio button expansion aka "smart mode" that when switching between node viewed look the expansion state of each of the component of the previous node and reproduce it if there is any overlap in component type.

Evidence context: shared Node editor toolbar, existing Collapse all components button. Browser annotation coordinate (1290, 52) in a 1480x764 viewport. Target: span.node-editor-view-tools > relational-ui-icon-button.
Implementation intent: one reusable Relational UI control with Collapsed, Expanded and Smart modes. Clicking either explicit mode repeats the action even when already selected and sets the default expansion mode for subsequent nodes. Smart transfers expansion state from the immediately previous node across matching component types. Defaults for unmatched types and conflicting states among repeated instances of a type remain to be established; do not silently invent accepted policy.

## Annotation 4 — unequal edge lengths with available space (verbatim)
there there is the opportunity of having same length edge but we don't have them.

Evidence context: same selected planning:buildspace/resolution/optional node and 67.03% zoom. The right-hand sparse branch shows unequal link lengths despite surrounding free space. Browser annotation coordinate (983, 278) in a 1480x764 viewport. Target: relational-ui-circle-graph > relational-ui-scroll-area.

## Resumption and verification
These layout observations are not yet diagnosed. Reproduce topology and rendered geometry through authored simulated inputs and persistent exact recordings before changing behavior, following the repository bug-fixing skill. Check whether parallel relations, force balance, collision constraints, or convergence contribute; these are investigation candidates, not confirmed causes. Evaluate node-to-edge clearance without imposing a universal equal-length guarantee that has not been agreed.
Integrate the expansion control into the shared Node editor construction path so all consumers benefit. Run focused tests for affected layout and Node editor consumers, mandatory type checks/build and visual verification; avoid the full test suite for this iteration.
The parent task already retains the deferred Query editor/composer work (nested expression authoring, interpreted typed queries, signatures/tooltips, initial expression editing and additive/restrictive roles). That remains pending separately from these four annotations.
The previous scrollbar flicker fix and shared toolbar consolidation are completed and should remain covered by their existing regression cases.

## Implementation and verification — 22 October 2026
The unchanged layout failed the authored sparse-star/parallel-relation and node-on-unrelated-edge recordings at radii 14 and 28. Expected output was established independently (equivalent layout constraints, star edge-length spread at most 4px, node-edge clearance). Before geometry and results are retained in RelationalUi/test-results/layout-spacing. The layout now uses one undirected spring per endpoint pair (all actual graph edges remain), a longer bounded settling period and spatially indexed node-to-edge repulsion. Work rotates through bounded edge batches for dense graphs. The existing hard circle-separation pass remains. Screenshot review caught a remaining overlap in a sparse branch attached to a 130-node hub; an additional exact recording reproduces that case and now reports zero branch overlaps. Dense hubs still have competing geometric constraints; equal lengths and universal crossing-free layouts are not promised.

ExpansionRadioButton is a reusable RelationalUi component, integrated into the common NodeEditor. Explicit modes repeat on activation and set defaults for subsequent nodes. Smart retains the current node state when selected and transfers expansion by component type from the immediately previous node. Iteration defaults stated in chat: unmatched types collapse; a type with mixed instance states expands if any previous instance was expanded. Same-node refresh preserves individual choices. Expanded remains the initial mode, matching existing behavior. These defaults are implementation choices for feedback, not additional user requirements.

Focused layout, NodeEditor and RefreshRadioButton unit recordings pass. Browser checks cover shared controls, repeated mouse/keyboard activation, preserved drafts, independent editors, real graph navigation and Smart transfer, shared authoring/inspection consumers, and the existing Fit/wheel stability regression. Screenshots were reviewed. Type safety passes with zero violations. The required root build completed successfully, followed by rebuilding the affected UI package and refreshing the generated model after the final lifecycle adjustment. The running app was restarted and the shared three-mode control verified on a real node.

Expansion preferences and the previous-node snapshot are scoped to the view's required tools host through a weak association, so consumers that replace the editor retain their mode without sharing it with independent views. This is covered by the exact NodeEditor recording. Final focused browser reruns pass for real graph navigation, shared Node editor controls/presentation and type inspection. Final screenshots are retained at .harness/design/graph-editor/spacing-iteration.png and expansion-iteration.png. Development for this small iteration is complete; the user will provide further feedback. Query composer rework remains queued.
properties.title: Improve graph spacing and shared component expansion modes
